subtitle: Living relationship planner
promotionalText: Plan your days, remember what matters, and show up for the people you love.
description: Plenara is a voice-first living planner and relational assistant. Capture tasks naturally, shape a realistic day or week, keep context about the people who matter, and revisit plans from clear Today, Plan, and Library surfaces. Common planning works on-device. Optional Anthropic features use your own API key and disclose the record categories they send. Your records remain readable files in the data folder you choose.

otherUserContent.reason: Optional BYOK Anthropic requests transmit the live request and the disclosed record categories needed for the requested cloud feature.

audioData.reason: Recognition is forced on-device and raw audio is never retained or transmitted by Plenara.

diagnostics.reason: External builds have no automatic telemetry or raw diagnostic capture/export.

reviewNotes: No Plenara account or backend. Offline planning is available immediately. Optional cloud features require a user-provided Anthropic API key. Voice recognition is on-device-only. User records are plaintext JSON in a user-selected folder; this is disclosed in onboarding, Settings, and the privacy policy.
